info.name: Stripe Get   Credit Notes Preview Lines

params.name: amount
params.description: The integer amount in cents (or local equivalent) representing the total amount of the credit note.

params.name: credit_amount
params.description: The integer amount in cents (or local equivalent) representing the amount to credit the customer's balance, which will be automatically applied to their next invoice.

params.name: effective_at
params.description: The date when this credit note is in effect. Same as `created` unless overwritten. When defined, this value replaces the system-generated 'Date of issue' printed on the credit note PDF.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

params.name: expand
params.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

params.name: invoice
params.description: ID of the invoice.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: lines
params.description: Line items that make up the credit note.

params.name: memo
params.description: The credit note's memo appears on the credit note PDF.

params.name: metadata
params.description: Set of [key-value pairs](https://stripe.com/docs/api/metadata) that you can attach to an object. This can be useful for storing additional information about the object in a structured format. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value to them. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to `metadata`.

params.name: out_of_band_amount
params.description: The integer amount in cents (or local equivalent) representing the amount that is credited outside of Stripe.

params.name: reason
params.description: Reason for issuing this credit note, one of `duplicate`, `fraudulent`, `order_change`, or `product_unsatisfactory`

params.name: refund
params.description: ID of an existing refund to link this credit note to.

params.name: refund_amount
params.description: The integer amount in cents (or local equivalent) representing the amount to refund. If set, a refund will be created for the charge associated with the invoice.

params.name: shipping_cost
params.description: When shipping_cost contains the shipping_rate from the invoice, the shipping_cost is included in the credit note.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.

items.docs: When retrieving a credit note preview, you’ll get a lines property containing the first handful of those items. This URL you can retrieve the full (paginated) list of line items.

params.name: automatic_tax
params.description: Settings for automatic tax lookup for this invoice preview.

params.name: coupon
params.description: The code of the coupon to apply. If `subscription` or `subscription_items` is provided, the invoice returned will preview updating or creating a subscription with that coupon. Otherwise, it will preview applying that coupon to the customer for the next upcoming invoice from among the customer's subscriptions. The invoice can be previewed without a coupon by passing this value as an empty string.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency to preview this invoice in. Defaults to that of `customer` if not specified.

params.name: customer
params.description: The identifier of the customer whose upcoming invoice you'd like to retrieve. If `automatic_tax` is enabled then one of `customer`, `customer_details`, `subscription`, or `schedule` must be set.

params.name: customer_details
params.description: Details about the customer you want to invoice or overrides for an existing customer. If `automatic_tax` is enabled then one of `customer`, `customer_details`, `subscription`, or `schedule` must be set.

params.name: discounts
params.description: The coupons to redeem into discounts for the invoice preview. If not specified, inherits the discount from the customer or subscription. This only works for coupons directly applied to the invoice. To apply a coupon to a subscription, you must use the `coupon` parameter instead. Pass an empty string to avoid inheriting any discounts. To preview the upcoming invoice for a subscription that hasn't been created, use `coupon` instead.

params.name: ending_before
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `ending_before` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, starting with `obj_bar`, your subsequent call can include `ending_before=obj_bar` in order to fetch the previous page of the list.

params.name: expand
params.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded.

params.name: invoice_items
params.description: List of invoice items to add or update in the upcoming invoice preview.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 10.

params.name: schedule
params.description: The identifier of the schedule whose upcoming invoice you'd like to retrieve. Cannot be used with subscription or subscription fields.

params.name: starting_after
params.description: A cursor for use in pagination. `starting_after` is an object ID that defines your place in the list. For instance, if you make a list request and receive 100 objects, ending with `obj_foo`, your subsequent call can include `starting_after=obj_foo` in order to fetch the next page of the list.

params.name: subscription
params.description: The identifier of the subscription for which you'd like to retrieve the upcoming invoice. If not provided, but a `subscription_items` is provided, you will preview creating a subscription with those items. If neither `subscription` nor `subscription_items` is provided, you will retrieve the next upcoming invoice from among the customer's subscriptions.

params.name: subscription_billing_cycle_anchor
params.description: For new subscriptions, a future timestamp to anchor the subscription's [billing cycle](https://stripe.com/docs/subscriptions/billing-cycle). This is used to determine the date of the first full invoice, and, for plans with `month` or `year` intervals, the day of the month for subsequent invoices. For existing subscriptions, the value can only be set to `now` or `unchanged`.

params.name: subscription_cancel_at
params.description: A timestamp at which the subscription should cancel. If set to a date before the current period ends, this will cause a proration if prorations have been enabled using `proration_behavior`. If set during a future period, this will always cause a proration for that period.

params.name: subscription_cancel_at_period_end
params.description: Boolean indicating whether this subscription should cancel at the end of the current period.

params.name: subscription_cancel_now
params.description: This simulates the subscription being canceled or expired immediately.

params.name: subscription_default_tax_rates
params.description: If provided, the invoice returned will preview updating or creating a subscription with these default tax rates. The default tax rates will apply to any line item that does not have `tax_rates` set.

params.name: subscription_items
params.description: A list of up to 20 subscription items, each with an attached price.

params.name: subscription_proration_behavior
params.description: Determines how to handle [prorations](https://stripe.com/docs/subscriptions/billing-cycle#prorations) when the billing cycle changes (e.g., when switching plans, resetting `billing_cycle_anchor=now`, or starting a trial), or if an item's `quantity` changes. The default value is `create_prorations`.

params.name: subscription_proration_date
params.description: If previewing an update to a subscription, and doing proration, `subscription_proration_date` forces the proration to be calculated as though the update was done at the specified time. The time given must be within the current subscription period and within the current phase of the schedule backing this subscription, if the schedule exists. If set, `subscription`, and one of `subscription_items`, or `subscription_trial_end` are required. Also, `subscription_proration_behavior` cannot be set to 'none'.

params.name: subscription_resume_at
params.description: For paused subscriptions, setting `subscription_resume_at` to `now` will preview the invoice that will be generated if the subscription is resumed.

params.name: subscription_start_date
params.description: Date a subscription is intended to start (can be future or past).

params.name: subscription_trial_end
params.description: If provided, the invoice returned will preview updating or creating a subscription with that trial end. If set, one of `subscription_items` or `subscription` is required.

params.name: subscription_trial_from_plan
params.description: Indicates if a plan's `trial_period_days` should be applied to the subscription. Setting `subscription_trial_end` per subscription is preferred, and this defaults to `false`. Setting this flag to `true` together with `subscription_trial_end` is not allowed. See [Using trial periods on subscriptions](https://stripe.com/docs/billing/subscriptions/trials) to learn more.

info.name: Stripe Post   Invoices Invoice Lines Line Item Id

params.name: invoice
params.description: Invoice ID of line item

params.name: line_item_id
params.description: Invoice line item ID

items.docs: Updates an invoice’s line item. Some fields, such as tax_amounts, only live on the invoice line item, so they can only be updated through this endpoint. Other fields, such as amount, live on both the invoice item and the invoice line item, so updates on this endpoint will propagate to the invoice item as well. Updating an invoice’s line item is only possible before the invoice is finalized.
